title: EAP-L3 — High Assurance Overlay
description: Machine-readable overlay defining the control applicability, evidence tightening, and dependency rules for EAP-L3 (High Assurance). Intended use: high-impact autonomy in safety, security, financial, and critical operations environments.

applicable_controls.note: External witnessing or anchoring for evidence chain heads strongly recommended.
evidence_tightening: Append-only hash-chained log with signed manifests required
Independent verification tooling or process must be documented
External anchoring or transparency log recommended (SHOULD)

applicable_controls.note: Strict rotation schedule and documented compromise playbook required.
evidence_tightening: Compromise playbook must include re-anchoring procedure

applicable_controls.note: Independent verification tooling or documented process required.
evidence_tightening: Verification must be exercised, not only documented

applicable_controls.note: Monotonic sequencing and cross-node ordering strategy required.
evidence_tightening: Monotonic sequencing required (not just wall clock)

applicable_controls.note: Replay detection must be demonstrated, not only documented.
evidence_tightening: Test result showing replay detection in controlled conditions required

applicable_controls.note: Strict network policy; enforcement layer must be the only invocation path.
evidence_tightening: Platform attestation expectations must be documented for safety kernel integrity where feasible
Explicit threat model boundaries required (see EAP-CTRL-009)

applicable_controls.note: All four attacker class categories must be addressed.
evidence_tightening: External, insider, compromised host, and supply chain attacker classes all required
Out-of-scope boundaries must be explicitly declared
Field-level encryption required (not redaction alone)
Export controls and watermarking recommended

applicable_controls.note: Audited evidence access with export controls required.
evidence_tightening: Export controls and access logs must be auditable

applicable_controls.note: Retention policy must align to jurisdiction and criticality.
evidence_tightening: Jurisdictional alignment must be documented explicitly
Tabletop exercise for evidence store breach scenario required

applicable_controls.note: Quarterly adversarial bypass tests plus registry tampering simulations required.
evidence_tightening: Quarterly cadence required
Registry tampering simulation scenario required (in addition to L2 scenarios)

applicable_controls.note: Semi-annual drills; at least one must assume vendor tooling unavailable.
evidence_tightening: Semi-annual cadence required
At least one drill per cycle must assume vendor dashboards or tooling unavailable

applicable_controls.note: Dual-control enforced; live-fire exercise in controlled environment required.
evidence_tightening: Dual-control must be enforced, not only documented
Live-fire exercise (not just tabletop) required
Evidence export and integrity verification post-exercise required
Policy Owner, Safety Kernel Operator, and Evidence Custodian must all be distinct
Policy Owner, Safety Kernel Operator, and Evidence Custodian separation all required
Dual-control configuration must be enforced at the system level
Evidence of two distinct authorizing identities required for each covered action
Supply chain attacker class must be addressed in threat model (see EAP-CTRL-009)

pass_criteria: All 20 controls assessed as 'pass' or 'waived' with documented waiver and residual risk acceptance. SHOULD controls documented with rationale if not met.
